description: Deliberate test (task_internet_egress_blocked): A one-off task in the worker's subnets and security group tries to open a connection to an internet address; it must fail. The newest recorded run must have passed within 30 days

matrix_rows.gap: Run once per environment session and recorded (cadence 30 days), not every 3: the environment it needs stands only during sessions.
Runtime fetches cannot occur from the app tier -- no route out, shown by the egress tests -- rather than being observed absent in egress records.
